thought.text: The form uses `user[login]`. Let me retry the login properly.

reasoning_content: The field is `user[login]` not `user[email]`. Let me redo login correctly.

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[login]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678" -o /tmp/login2.html -w "status=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n"; echo "current-user landing:"; curl -s -b cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | grep -o 'data-current-user-id="[^"]*"'; echo "admin:"; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/admin
